R. s. 4</cite> <he>לעִרְבּוּבוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="M00890"><he>מַחֲלוֹקֶת</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>עִרְבּוּבִים</he>, <cite ref="P00072"><he>עִי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:9">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 18:25">Gen. XVIII, 25</cite>) <he>עִירְבּוּבֵי שאילות יש כאן</he> there is a fusion of questions in this sentence (an interchange of queries between Abraham and God); Yalk. ib. 83.
